profile.name: Joel Darla
profile.tagline: Building reliable data pipelines, modern lakehouse platforms, and analytics-ready datasets.
profile.summary: Data Engineer focused on Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, SQL, PySpark, and Power BI. I enjoy turning raw data into well-governed, reliable data products that help teams make faster decisions.

highlights: Build and support data workflows for ingestion, transformation, validation, and analytics.
Work with SQL, modern data platforms, pipeline orchestration, and reporting solutions.
Translate data requirements into reliable datasets and repeatable engineering workflows.

projects.title: Retail Analytics Lakehouse
projects.subtitle: Microsoft Fabric · End-to-End Data Engineering
projects.description: An end-to-end retail analytics platform that ingests raw sales data, applies Bronze–Silver–Gold transformations, and prepares trusted business datasets for Power BI reporting.
projects.problem: Retail data arrives from multiple sources and requires repeatable cleaning, modelling, and reporting.
projects.solution: Orchestrated ingestion into a Fabric Lakehouse, transformed datasets with PySpark/SQL, and created curated Gold-layer tables.
impact: Automated a repeatable ingestion and transformation flow
Added data-quality checks for nulls and duplicates
Produced analytics-ready Gold datasets for reporting

projects.title: E-Commerce Data Pipeline
projects.subtitle: ADF + Databricks · Batch Data Platform
projects.description: A modular Azure pipeline for ingesting e-commerce data, transforming it in Databricks, and publishing Delta tables for downstream analytics.
projects.problem: Daily source files need reliable ingestion, schema validation, transformation, and incremental processing.
projects.solution: Used ADF for orchestration and Databricks/PySpark for scalable transformations with Delta Lake storage.
impact: Separated raw, cleansed, and curated data layers

projects.title: Operations KPI Data Mart
projects.subtitle: SQL + Power BI · Analytics Engineering
projects.description: A compact analytics-engineering project that converts operational data into a dimensional model for KPI tracking and executive reporting.
projects.problem: Operational metrics are spread across raw tables and are difficult for business teams to consume consistently.
projects.solution: Created reusable SQL transformations, fact/dimension tables, KPI logic, and a Power BI-ready semantic structure.
